leadText: Volume 4 is the fourth volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.
plainText:
Volume 4 is the fourth volume published by Kurokawa compiling chapters from the of the Pokémon Adventures manga created by Hidenori Kusaka and Satoshi Yamamoto. As the chapters of the Black & White arc included in this volume had not yet been published in graphic novel format in Japan, the chapters in this volume have been collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Le choc (« The Shock »)
L’emprise de N (« N's Influence »)
La détermination de Blanche (« White's Determination »)
Nouveau départ (« A Fresh New Start »)
Embrouilles au pont Yoneuve (« Trouble at Driftveil Drawbridge »)
Passager clandestin (« One Stowaway »)
Tcheren dans la tourmente ! (« Cheren's Turmoil! »)
Duel au ras du sol ! (« Battle at Ground Level »)

==Major events==
 
N reveals that he is Team Plasma's king.
Gigi betrays for N.
N gives White a .
meets Marshal and Alder.
White decides to become a Pokémon Trainer and learn about battling.
White and Black go their separate ways.
Black lends White Brav.
Black meets Clay.
White meets Shauntal.
Team Plasma captures , , and .
Black meets up with again.
